name: Analytical Reasoning
shortcutSummary: Create a matrix/table with all variables. List all conditions. Fill in definite clues first, then use elimination. Cross off impossible combinations systematically.
conceptExplanation: Analytical Reasoning involves complex multi-condition puzzles where you must match people to attributes, positions, or items based on a set of conditions. These require systematic tabulation.

subtopics.name: Analytical Reasoning — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Analytical Reasoning involves complex multi-condition puzzles where you must match people to attributes, positions, or items based on a set of conditions. These require systematic tabulation.
shortcuts: Matrix Method: Create a grid of all possible assignments and eliminate based on clues.
Definite Clues First: Always start with clues that give absolute information.
Cross-Elimination: When you confirm one assignment, eliminate that option for all other variables.
